2. Actual small control torque from prop desat coupling into roll (structured bump after desat suggests this).
3. Wheel current bump could be controller responding to real or perceived rate error.
4. Could be a transient sensor/processing issue due to packet loss/handover.

Recommendations:
1. Quick-look check of the momentum management mode transition and wheel speed/tach data around desat to see if the wheel current was commanded or reactive.
2. Verify the attitude error (not just rate) stayed within pointing budget during the bump.
3. Consider a brief hold or shortened attitude trim before full imaging to verify no oscillatory behavior.
4. Given inconsistency in peak magnitude/timing between onboard and ground data, request a coherence check on the attitude determination source (e.g., which sensors were used) before finalizing trim.
